style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Lane Cove, Australia Land Sale</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">On September 9, 2026, we completed the sale of land for a previously closed facility in Lane Cove, Australia for cash proceeds and resulting pre-tax gain of $26 million. The pre-tax gain was recorded in Restructuring/impairment charges, net on our Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income.</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">    </span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> </span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Vanscoy, Canada Plant Sale</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">On August 21, 2026, we completed the sale of our Vanscoy, Canada plant for cash proceeds of $8 million. As part of the sale, we recorded a pre-tax impairment charge of $3 million, which we recorded to Restructuring/impairment charges, net on our Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income.</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">     </span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Cabo, Brazil Cessation of Operations</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">On May&#160;1, 2026, we committed to a plan to cease operations at our Cabo, Brazil facility in our F&amp;II&#8211;LATAM segment as of June 30, 2026. For year-to-date and the quarter ended September 30, 2026, we recorded pre-tax charges of $48&#160;million and $5&#160;million to Restructuring/impairment charges, net on our Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income. The pre-tax charges year-to-date included $31&#160;million for impairment charges relating to fixed assets and $17&#160;million for inventory write-downs, severance payments and other termination-related costs. For the third quarter and year-to-date 2026, there were other non-recurring restructuring costs of $4 million and $17 million.</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Supply Chain Finance Programs</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Under supply chain finance programs administered by third-party banks, our suppliers have the opportunity to sell receivables due from us to participating financing institutions and receive earlier payment at a discount. Our responsibility is limited to making payment on the terms originally negotiated with our supplier, regardless of whether such supplier sells its receivable to a financial institution. The payment terms we negotiate with a supplier are independent of whether such supplier participates in a supply chain finance program, and participation in any such program by a supplier has no effect on our income or cash flows.</span></div><div style="margin-top:12pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">As of September&#160;30, 2026 and December&#160;31, 2025, participating financial institutions held $127&#160;million and $148&#160;million of our liabilities recorded in Accounts payable and Accrued liabilities and liabilities held for sale on our Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets. As of September&#160;30, 2026, supply chain finance programs existed primarily for operations in Brazil, the U.S., Thailand, Mexico, China, Colombia, and Peru, and for operations of certain PureCircle entities.</span></div><span></span>
